newsitem.title: USA: Pomeroy Computer gets $43 mln in contracts.
newsitem.headline: Pomeroy Computer gets $43 mln in contracts.

text.p: Pomeroy Computer Resources said on Tuesday that it has received two contracts with a total estimated value over the next 18 months of more than $43 million.

Pomeroy said that a national financial services provider based in Ohio selected the company as one of its network server and desktop printer providers through the award of a contract that will generate an estimated $37 million of revenues over the next 18 months.

A national stock brokerage firm based in Tennessee awarded Pomeroy a contract for networking products and services that will generate an estimated $6 million of revenues over the next 12 months, it said.
